blurb: Brentwood Splash Park is a 10,000 sq. ft. interactive venue featuring multiple slides, ground and ring sprays, and a 100 gallon dump bucket. It is part of the Indoor Sports Complex located at 920 Heritage Way, Brentwood, TN. The splash park is seasonal and closed for the season, reopening in May 2027.
extraNote: At the sound of thunder, the pool will be cleared until 30 minutes after the last sound of thunder; patrons may remain on deck during this time. · For lightning, patrons must exit the facility; facility remains closed until 30 minutes after last observed lightning. · Splash Parks remain open during light rain if no thunder or lightning. · Closed for the season; reopens May 2027
